meaning_en: to pile stones into waymarkers / erect a cairn

past.ar: رَجَمَ الدَّلِيلُ حِجَارَةَ الرَّجْمِ فِي المَمَرِّ
past.de: Der Kundige schichtete das Steinmal am Pass auf
past.en: The desert guide piled the landmark stones at the pass

present.de: Er schichtet Wegmale auf, damit Reisende den Weg finden
present.en: He stacks cairns so wayfarers may orient themselves

imperative.en: Stack with steadfast rocks that withstand time!
